name: Aalto Speech Recognition
summary: Speech recognition group at Aalto University, long-term open-source publisher of the Morfessor morphology tool and AaltoASR toolkit.
openness: Tools are open source on GitHub.

name: AdapterHub
summary: Open-source community and library for parameter-efficient and modular transfer learning, started by researchers around UKP Lab in Darmstadt.
openness: Fully open-source library and adapter checkpoints on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: Agentica
summary: Open-source initiative from Berkeley's Sky Computing Lab releasing RL-trained models such as DeepScaleR and DeepCoder and the rLLM framework.
openness: Open weights, data and code.

name: AI Singapore
summary: National AI programme (government-funded) behind the SEA-LION family of Southeast Asian language models.
openness: Weights on Hugging Face and code on GitHub.

name: AI Sweden
summary: Sweden's national centre for applied AI, a partnership between public and private organisations. Its model hub hosts the GPT-SW3 Nordic language models and related resources.
focus: language models; Swedish; Nordic languages; applied AI
openness: Publishes models and datasets on Hugging Face; individual licences vary, so check each model card.

name: AI21 Labs
summary: Israeli enterprise AI company. Partly open: Jamba models are published on Hugging Face while products are commercial.
openness: Selected open weights; licence per model card.

name: AI4Bharat
summary: Non-profit initiative at IIT Madras building open datasets, models and applications for Indian languages.
openness: Open datasets, models and code.

name: AiLab
summary: Artificial Intelligence Laboratory at the Institute of Mathematics and Computer Science, University of Latvia, active since 1992 and building open Latvian language resources such as Tezaurs and FullStack-LV.
openness: Language resources and models are public on GitHub.

name: AIML Lab
summary: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Lab at TU Darmstadt, open-sourcing safety tooling for vision-language and diffusion models such as LlavaGuard and Safe Latent Diffusion.
openness: Models, datasets and code are public on Hugging Face and GitHub (ml-research).

name: Aleph Alpha
summary: Heidelberg language-model company that publishes part of its research as open weights and datasets alongside commercial products.
openness: Mixed: flagship products are commercial, but model weights, datasets and code are public on Hugging Face and GitHub.

name: Alexandra Institute
summary: Danish non-profit research and technology institute with open Danish NLP resources including DaNLP and the ScandEval benchmark.
openness: Models, datasets and tools are public under the alexandrainst accounts on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: Allen Institute for AI
summary: Seattle-based nonprofit research institute building fully open language models (OLMo), datasets (Dolma), post-training recipes (Tulu) and science and vision tools.
openness: Releases weights, training code and data, mostly under Apache-2.0.

name: ALMAnaCH
summary: Inria Paris research team on language models and computational humanities, creators of the CamemBERT family of French language models.
focus: NLP; French; language models; digital humanities
openness: Models and datasets are public on Hugging Face under the almanach organisation; CamemBERT checkpoints have very high download counts.

name: Answer.AI
summary: Practical AI R&D lab founded by Jeremy Howard and Eric Ries as a public benefit corporation, shipping open-source libraries and models such as ModernBERT, FastHTML, nbdev and RAGatouille.
focus: encoder models; developer tools; retrieval; efficient fine-tuning
openness: Apache-2.0 code on GitHub and Apache-2.0 model weights on Hugging Face.

name: Apollo Research
summary: London-based AI safety research organisation studying deceptive behaviour, evaluations and mechanistic interpretability, publishing code and datasets on GitHub and Hugging Face.
openness: Research code, SAE weights and datasets are public; its evaluations of frontier models are published as papers.

name: Arc Institute
summary: Nonprofit biomedical research institute that releases open AI models for biology such as Evo 2, State and Stack.
openness: Open weights and data.

name: ARC Prize Foundation
summary: Nonprofit running the ARC-AGI benchmarks and prize competitions with open datasets and tooling.
openness: Open benchmark data and code.

name: Arcee AI
summary: San Francisco company training and releasing open models (AFM, Trinity) and tools such as MergeKit and DistillKit.
openness: Open weights and permissive code.

name: audEERING
summary: Audio AI company near Munich, maker of the open-source openSMILE toolkit and widely used speech emotion and age-gender models.
openness: Commercial company with a large public footprint: tools and several models are open on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: AutoML Groups
summary: AutoML research groups at the Universities of Freiburg and Hannover, creators of auto-sklearn, Auto-PyTorch and SMAC3. The shared automl.org site was closed in August 2026.
openness: Libraries are open source on GitHub under the automl organisation.

name: BAAI
summary: Describes itself as a private non-profit AI research and development organisation in Beijing. Publishes models and datasets on Hugging Face.
focus: datasets; language models; embodied AI; Chinese
openness: Models and datasets on Hugging Face; licences vary per release.

name: Bespoke Labs
summary: Startup building tools and open models for data curation and verifiable fine-tuning, and a lead team behind the OpenThoughts project.
openness: Apache-2.0 Curator library; open weights and datasets such as Bespoke-Stratos and MiniCheck on Hugging Face.

name: Bethge Lab
summary: Bethge Lab at the University of Tuebingen studies robustness and human-like vision, releasing Foolbox and several robustness benchmarks.
openness: Code and datasets are open on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: BharatGen
summary: India-focused consortium releasing language, speech and vision models plus the BhashaBench evaluation suite. Government-funded.
openness: Weights on Hugging Face.

name: BigCode
summary: BigCode is an open scientific collaboration, run by Hugging Face and ServiceNow Research, on code language models. It released the StarCoder models, The Stack datasets and evaluation tools. Independence is partial because two companies host it.
openness: Open weights under the BigCode OpenRAIL-M family, with datasets and code public.

name: BigScience
summary: BigScience was a year-long open research workshop that produced the BLOOM multilingual language model and many related datasets and tools. Hosting is on Hugging Face, and the project is now mainly an archive. City is a placeholder for a distributed collaboration.
openness: Open weights, datasets and code, with BLOOM under the Responsible AI License.

name: Bioptimus
summary: Paris startup building foundation models for biology and pathology. It has released the H-optimus pathology models on Hugging Face.
openness: Selected models are available on Hugging Face; check each model card for its licence, which may restrict commercial use.

name: Black Forest Labs
summary: Image and video generation lab behind the FLUX model family. It releases several open-weight variants alongside commercial API models.
openness: Some FLUX models (e.g. schnell) are Apache-2.0; others are open weights under non-commercial licences; inference code is Apache-2.0.

name: Boltz
summary: Public-benefit company growing out of MIT research that develops open biomolecular foundation models (Boltz-1, Boltz-2) for structure and binding-affinity prediction.
focus: biomolecular modelling; structure prediction; drug discovery
openness: MIT-licensed code and weights.

name: Browser Use
summary: Open-source library and company for AI browser agents, with a small open model.
openness: MIT-licensed library and model.

name: BSC Language Technologies Lab
summary: Language technologies group at the Barcelona Supercomputing Center that trains the Salamandra and ALIA open models for Spanish, Catalan and other European languages.
openness: Models are published openly on Hugging Face; the Salamandra code repositories are Apache-2.0.

name: BUET CSE NLP Group
summary: University research group on low-resource Bangla NLP, releasing BanglaBERT and BanglaT5.
openness: Open models and datasets.

name: BUT Speech@FIT
summary: Speech and language research group at Brno University of Technology, open-sourcing speaker diarization toolkits and Czech language models.
focus: speech processing; speaker diarization; Czech LLMs
openness: Toolkits and models are public on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: Canopy Labs
summary: Speech AI lab behind Orpheus, an Apache-2.0 family of Llama-based text-to-speech models.
openness: Apache-2.0 Orpheus code and weights.

name: Cardiff NLP
summary: Cardiff NLP is the NLP group at Cardiff University, known for TweetEval, TweetNLP and the Twitter-RoBERTa models used widely for social media analysis.
openness: Models, datasets and libraries are public on Hugging Face and GitHub.

name: Cartesia
summary: Voice AI company that also publishes open state-space language models such as Rene and Llamba.
openness: Some open weights.

name: Center for AI Safety
summary: Nonprofit AI safety research organisation that releases open benchmarks such as MMLU-related sets, HarmBench, WMDP and Humanity's Last Exam.
openness: Open benchmarks and code.

name: Center for Humanities Computing
summary: Aarhus University centre applying NLP to the humanities, authors of DaCy and the Scandinavian Embedding Benchmarks.
openness: Code, models and corpora are public on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: Chai Discovery
summary: AI drug-discovery startup that open-sourced the Chai-1 biomolecular structure model.
openness: Open weights and code.

name: CIS, LMU Munich
summary: Centre for Information and Language Processing at LMU Munich, behind SimAlign, Glot500 and GlotLID for massively multilingual NLP.
focus: multilingual NLP; low-resource languages; language identification
openness: Code, models and corpora are public on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: CJVT
summary: Centre for Language Resources and Technologies at the University of Ljubljana, which publishes Slovene language models, corpora and tools including the GaMS model family.
openness: Models and corpora are public on Hugging Face and GitHub, with licences set per project.

name: CKIP Lab
summary: Non-profit NLP lab publishing Chinese NLP models including Han Chinese models.
openness: Models on Hugging Face and code on GitHub.

name: CLARIN-PL
summary: CLARIN-PL is the Polish language technology infrastructure based at Wroclaw University of Science and Technology, publishing Polish NLP tools, models, benchmarks and corpora.
openness: Code, models and datasets are public on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: CLASSLA
summary: CLARIN knowledge centre providing open tools, models and corpora for Slovenian, Croatian, Serbian, Bosnian and Montenegrin.
focus: South Slavic NLP; language models; corpora
openness: Tools, models and datasets are public on Hugging Face and GitHub.

name: CLiPS
summary: Computational linguistics group in Antwerp, creators of the Pattern web-mining library and Dutch embedding and FAQ resources.
openness: Code, datasets and models are public on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: CLTL
summary: Computational Linguistics and Text Mining Lab at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, with open teaching material, Dutch wordnet resources and a Dutch medical language model.
openness: Courses, tools, datasets and models are public on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: Common Crawl Foundation
summary: Nonprofit that publishes a free, open repository of web crawl data used to train many language models.
openness: Data free to use; code open source.

name: CompVis
summary: Computer Vision and Learning group at LMU Munich, creators of latent diffusion and the research behind Stable Diffusion. It continues to publish open code and models.
openness: Code is published on GitHub and weights on Hugging Face, with licences varying by project.

name: Contextual AI
summary: Enterprise RAG company whose research arm releases open alignment libraries and retrieval and reranker models.
openness: Apache-2.0 and MIT code; open reranker and research models.

name: Crane AI Labs
summary: Crane AI Labs describes itself as building culturally relevant AI for the Global South. Its Hugging Face org hosts Swahili and Luganda Gemma-based models, tokenizers and benchmark datasets.
openness: Models and datasets are public on Hugging Face; base models carry their upstream licence terms. Country comes from press coverage, not the org page.

name: Danish Foundation Models
summary: Danish community and research project building open foundation models, datasets and evaluations for Danish, led from Aarhus University's Center for Humanities Computing with partners.
openness: Datasets, models and code are public; the Dynaword corpus is built from openly licensed sources.

name: Deep Cogito
summary: AI lab releasing open-weight hybrid reasoning models trained with iterated distillation and amplification.
openness: Open model weights on Hugging Face (several under permissive or llama-style licences).

name: Deep Learning Indaba
summary: Deep Learning Indaba strengthens machine learning in Africa through an annual conference, schools and community programmes, run by a non-profit company registered in the UK. Its GitHub organisation publishes open practical notebooks from each Indaba.
openness: Teaching notebooks are open on GitHub; it does not train large models. Borderline inclusion as an education and community body.

name: DeepSeek
summary: Hangzhou-based AI lab that publishes large language and reasoning models. Its Hugging Face organisation hosts more than 100 models and is among the most followed in the field.
openness: Model weights are published on Hugging Face; licences vary by release (check each model card).

name: deepset
summary: Berlin company that maintains Haystack, an open-source framework for building LLM and RAG applications, and has released German language models and datasets.
openness: Haystack is Apache-2.0 and most models are openly licensed; the commercial platform is separate.

name: DFKI
summary: DFKI is the German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence, a non-profit research company with several sites, publishing research code and datasets on GitHub and Hugging Face.
openness: Multiple public repositories and Hugging Face datasets; DFKI is broad, so openness varies by project.

name: DICTA: Israel Center for Text Analysis
summary: Non-profit building Hebrew language models and tools, including the DictaLM open-weight collection.
openness: Open-weight Hebrew models.

name: Digital Umuganda
summary: Digital Umuganda works on African language NLP, speech and data collection, with a focus on Kinyarwanda and other languages. Its Hugging Face org hosts speech models and the AfriVoice datasets.
openness: Models and datasets are public on Hugging Face; licences per repo. Only the Hugging Face org was opened, so website and legal form are unverified.

name: DTAI
summary: Machine learning and AI group at KU Leuven; its researchers released the RobBERT Dutch language models.
openness: RobBERT models are public on Hugging Face under the DTAI-KULeuven organisation.

name: EdinburghNLP
summary: Natural language processing group at the University of Edinburgh, behind open tools and datasets including the Nematus NMT toolkit and the XSum summarisation dataset.
openness: Code and datasets are public on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: EleutherAI
summary: EleutherAI is a non-profit research institute that trains and releases open models, datasets and tools. It began in 2020 as a Discord server and incorporated in 2023.
focus: language models; evaluation; interpretability; datasets; distributed
openness: Open weights, datasets and code.

name: ellamind
summary: German company working on AI evaluation, data and agents. It open-sources tooling for evaluation and inference and publishes models and datasets.
openness: Code is mostly MIT or Apache-2.0; models and datasets are public on Hugging Face.

name: ELLIS Alicante
summary: ELLIS Alicante is a non-profit research unit of the ELLIS network focused on human-centric AI, with research code and benchmarks on GitHub.
openness: Paper code and evaluation repositories are public on GitHub.

name: EPFL LLM Team
summary: EPFL team behind Meditron, open medical LLMs, and the Megatron-LLM trainer.
openness: Weights, data and training code are public on Hugging Face and GitHub.

name: Epoch AI
summary: Research organisation that tracks AI compute, data, algorithms and hardware trends, publishing public datasets and analysis code.
openness: Datasets published openly on epoch.ai; analysis code on GitHub, mostly MIT.

name: Essential AI
summary: San Francisco lab releasing open models (Rnj-1) and the Essential-Web dataset.
openness: Open weights and data.

name: EuroLLM
summary: EuroLLM is a series of open multilingual language models for European languages, developed by a consortium of European research institutions and companies under the UTTER project.
focus: language models; multilingual; European languages; translation
openness: Model weights and instruction data are public on Hugging Face; the technical report is open.

name: Explosion
summary: Berlin software company that created spaCy and Thinc, open-source libraries for NLP and machine learning.
openness: Core libraries are released under the MIT licence.

name: FAR.AI
summary: AI safety research nonprofit publishing open code for adversarial robustness and interpretability research.
openness: MIT and Apache-2.0 research code on GitHub.

name: fast.ai
summary: Research and education lab behind the fastai library and free deep learning courses.
openness: Open-source Apache-2.0 code and free courses.

name: FBK Machine Translation Unit
summary: Machine translation and speech research unit at Fondazione Bruno Kessler that publishes open speech and translation datasets and code.
openness: Code and datasets are public on GitHub and Hugging Face under Apache-2.0 for several repositories.

name: Flowers
summary: Inria research team on developmental and curiosity-driven AI, open-ended learning and grounding language models through reinforcement learning.
focus: reinforcement learning; open-ended learning; LLM agents; robotics
openness: Research code is released openly in the flowersteam GitHub organisation, typically alongside papers.

name: FutureHouse
summary: Nonprofit AI-for-science lab building language agents and open models for scientific discovery.
focus: AI for science; agents; chemistry; biology benchmarks
openness: Apache-2.0 code; open ether0 weights and benchmark datasets on Hugging Face.

name: Genmo
summary: Video generation lab that released Mochi 1 as an open model.
openness: Open weights (Apache-2.0).

name: Gensyn
summary: London-based machine learning research and production lab building decentralised training and verification infrastructure. It open-sources frameworks such as RL Swarm and also works on tools like REE and Delphi information markets.
openness: Main repositories are open source, mostly under MIT.

name: Ghana NLP
summary: Ghana NLP is an open-source initiative working on NLP for Ghanaian languages and applications to local problems. It publishes Twi and other language models and parallel text datasets on Hugging Face and code on GitHub.
focus: low-resource languages; language models; datasets; machine translation
openness: Models and datasets are published on Hugging Face and code on GitHub; licences differ per resource.

name: Giskard
summary: Paris company building evaluation and red-teaming tools for AI agents and LLMs. It maintains an open-source testing library and publishes safety benchmarks.
openness: Core library is Apache-2.0 on GitHub; benchmarks are public on Hugging Face.

name: Goodfire
summary: Interpretability research lab releasing open sparse autoencoders and interpretability artefacts.
openness: Open SAE weights and code.

name: Gorilla
summary: UC Berkeley research project releasing open LLMs and the Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard for tool and API use.
openness: Apache-2.0 code, models and datasets.

name: GPT-NL
summary: Dutch non-profit collaboration between TNO, NFI and SURF building a responsible Dutch language model, publishing its permissioned public training corpus on Hugging Face.
openness: Public corpus and datasets are open on Hugging Face; open model weights could not be verified at the time of checking.

name: GroNLP
summary: Computational linguistics group at the University of Groningen, known for BERTje, HateBERT and Dutch GPT-2 models.
openness: Models and datasets are public on Hugging Face.

name: H Company
summary: Paris-based AI company building computer-use and web agents. It releases its Holo vision-language models as open weights on Hugging Face.
openness: Holo models checked on Hugging Face carry Apache-2.0 licences; datasets and demo spaces are also public.

name: Hazy Research
summary: Stanford group releasing open efficient-architecture research such as ThunderKittens kernels, Based and Hyena models.
openness: Open code and weights.

name: Heidelberg NLP
summary: Computational linguistics group at Heidelberg University, releasing benchmarks and models such as VALSE and Graph Language Models.
openness: Code and benchmarks are public on GitHub.

name: Helsinki-NLP
summary: Language technology research group at the University of Helsinki, creators of the OPUS-MT open translation models and OPUS parallel corpora.
openness: Over a thousand translation models and corpora are public on Hugging Face; code is mostly MIT.

name: HiTZ Basque Center for Language Technology
summary: Basque Center for Language Technology at the University of the Basque Country, which publishes Basque and multilingual language models and information-extraction tools.
focus: Basque; language models; information extraction; speech
openness: Models, datasets and code are public on Hugging Face and GitHub.

name: Hooshvare Research Lab
summary: Non-profit lab publishing Persian NLP models such as ParsBERT and Persian GPT-2.
openness: Open models.

name: HPC-AI Tech
summary: Company behind Colossal-AI distributed training tooling and the Open-Sora video generation models.
openness: Open-source code and model weights.

name: HPLT
summary: EU-funded consortium coordinated from Charles University that publishes petabyte-scale multilingual web corpora, translation models and data-cleaning tools.
focus: multilingual datasets; machine translation; language models
openness: Datasets, models and tools are public (the HPLT3.0 card lists CC0).

name: Hugging Face
summary: The company behind the Hugging Face Hub and open-source libraries such as Transformers, Diffusers and Datasets. Headquartered in New York with a large Paris presence, it hosts the main community platform for open models and datasets.
focus: model hub; libraries; datasets; small language models; robotics
openness: Core libraries are Apache-2.0; the Hub hosts open models and datasets and the company publishes its own models, datasets and training recipes openly.

name: Hungarian Research Centre for Linguistics
summary: Language technology research group that publishes the PULI family of Hungarian language models along with corpora and the e-magyar text processing system.
openness: Models and datasets are public on Hugging Face and GitHub; some model cards use Llama-based licences.

name: Idiap Research Institute
summary: Independent Swiss non-profit research institute in speech, vision and machine learning that publishes extensive open-source code.
openness: Large GitHub organisation; models and spaces are on Hugging Face.

name: Illuin Technology
summary: Paris AI company whose research team co-created ColPali visual document retrieval and the ViDoRe benchmark, and co-authored the CroissantLLM bilingual model.
focus: document retrieval; vision-language models; NLP; evaluation
openness: Publishes research code, benchmarks and datasets under its illuin-tech GitHub organisation and illuin Hugging Face organisation; consulting and products are commercial.

name: ILSP / Athena Research Center
summary: Institute for Language and Speech Processing of Athena Research Center, which builds open Greek language models such as Meltemi and Llama-Krikri.
openness: Models and evaluation datasets are public on Hugging Face.

name: INSAIT
summary: AI and computer science research institute at Sofia University. It publishes the BgGPT and MamayLM language models and computer-vision research code.
openness: Models and code are public on Hugging Face and GitHub; models adapted from third-party bases carry those licences.

name: Institute for Machine Learning, JKU Linz
summary: Machine learning institute at Johannes Kepler University Linz, known for LSTM, modern Hopfield networks and xLSTM.
openness: Code is public on GitHub and datasets on Hugging Face.

name: Institute of Computer Science PAS
summary: Institute of Computer Science of the Polish Academy of Sciences, publishing open Polish retrieval models and question answering datasets.
openness: Models and datasets are published on the ipipan Hugging Face organisation.

name: Institute of Foundation Models
summary: Research institute at MBZUAI in Abu Dhabi that sponsors LLM360, the open model and data effort. The legacy LLM360 Hugging Face organization notes that its namespace has moved to the Institute of Foundation Models.
openness: LLM360 is known for releasing training artefacts; the legacy HF org shows no public models.

name: ISSAI
summary: AI institute at Nazarbayev University working on Kazakh-language AI.
openness: Models on Hugging Face and code on GitHub.

name: JeRTeh
summary: Serbian society for language resources and technologies that releases Serbian GPT-2 and BERT-style models and corpora.
openness: Models and datasets are public on Hugging Face and GitHub.

name: KBLab
summary: Data-science lab within the National Library of Sweden that builds language and speech models from the library's collections. Its models are openly available on Hugging Face.
openness: Models and datasets are public on Hugging Face; check each card for licence terms.

name: Kempelen Institute of Intelligent Technologies
summary: Slovak independent research institute for AI that publishes Slovak language models, speech recognition models and benchmarks.
openness: Models, datasets and code are public on Hugging Face and GitHub.

name: Kotoba Technologies
summary: Voice AI company, incorporated in 2023 with offices in San Francisco and Tokyo, that released the Kotoba-Whisper Japanese speech recognition models and builds real-time speech and translation models.
openness: Weights on Hugging Face, code on GitHub.

name: Kyutai
summary: Paris-based open-science AI lab focused on speech and multimodal models. It publishes weights, code and papers for its work.
focus: speech; multimodal; language models; open science
openness: Models and code are released openly, mostly under Apache-2.0 or MIT licences, with technical papers.

name: LAION
summary: LAION is a non-profit making datasets, tools and models openly available for research. It also co-organised the OpenAssistant crowd-sourced conversation project.
openness: Datasets, models and code are open with mixed licences.

name: lang-uk
summary: Volunteer community for Ukrainian natural language processing that publishes open datasets, tools and models.
openness: Code, models and datasets are public on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: Language and Voice Lab
summary: Reykjavik University lab building open Icelandic speech recognition and synthesis models and large speech corpora.
openness: Models and datasets are public on Hugging Face under the lab organisation.

name: Language Technologies Unit
summary: Welsh language technology unit at Bangor University releasing Welsh speech, translation and language models.
openness: Many repositories are public on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: Language Technology Group, University of Oslo
summary: NLP research group at the University of Oslo that has released Norwegian corpora, benchmarks and NorMistral language models.
openness: Models, corpora and code are public on Hugging Face and GitHub under mostly open licences.

name: Latam-GPT
summary: Latam-GPT is a Latin American language model project coordinated by CENIA, Chile's national AI centre. It publishes models, a regional text corpus, benchmarks and data-curation tools openly.
focus: language models; datasets; evaluation; low-resource languages
openness: Weights, corpus and tools are public on Hugging Face and GitHub; the SFT model carries a Llama 3.1 licence and the corpus a custom licence.

name: Lelapa AI
summary: Lelapa AI is a South African startup building language AI for African languages, including a commercial speech and translation product called Vulavula. It also releases research models and datasets openly, notably InkubaLM.
focus: language models; speech; low-resource languages; datasets
openness: Research models and datasets are on Hugging Face (InkubaLM-0.4B is listed under CC BY-NC 4.0); the commercial Vulavula product is closed.

name: Letta
summary: San Francisco AI research lab from the creators of MemGPT, building open-source stateful agents.
openness: Open-source code.

name: Lightblue
summary: Tokyo firm that releases open models such as rerankers on Hugging Face.
openness: Weights on Hugging Face.

name: Lightly
summary: Zurich startup open-sourcing self-supervised learning and vision training libraries.
openness: Open-source libraries with a commercial platform alongside.

name: Lightning AI
summary: Company behind PyTorch Lightning, LitGPT and LitServe, open-source frameworks for training and serving models.
openness: Open-source Apache-2.0 libraries; commercial cloud alongside.

name: LightOn
summary: Paris-based AI company working on enterprise search and document understanding. It open-sources retrieval models, OCR models and multi-vector search tools.
openness: Publishes models, datasets and libraries on Hugging Face and GitHub, mostly under MIT or Apache-2.0 for code; check model cards for model licences.

name: LINAGORA
summary: French open-source software company behind the LinTO speech stack and partner in the Lucie French-focused open LLM project.
openness: Long-standing open-source publisher (GitHub and Hugging Face), including speech models and datasets under open licences.

name: Liquid AI
summary: MIT spin-out building efficient on-device foundation models (LFM) with open-weight releases.
openness: Open weights under the LFM Open License.

name: LLM-jp
summary: Community of over 1,000 researchers and engineers coordinated by Japan's National Institute of Informatics, building Japanese-capable open LLMs.
openness: Open models, tools and corpora on Hugging Face and GitHub.

name: LMArena
summary: Berkeley-origin group behind Chatbot Arena, FastChat/Vicuna and RouteLLM; releases open evaluation data and tools.
openness: Open code and preference datasets.

name: Maincode
summary: Maincode is a Melbourne AI company that describes itself as independent and runs its own hardware. It has released some models on Hugging Face, including Maincoder-1B and Matilda base models, while its main Matilda product is not open-weight.
openness: Selected models are open on Hugging Face; the commercial flagship is not. Borderline inclusion.

name: MaiNLP
summary: Munich AI and NLP lab at LMU Munich, publishing datasets and code on human label variation, relation extraction and low-resource Germanic languages.
openness: Datasets and code are public on GitHub.

name: Marin
summary: Open lab for developing foundation models with fully open experiments; releases Marin 8B and 32B.
openness: Fully open code, data and logs.

name: MBZUAI
summary: Graduate-level AI university in Abu Dhabi that publishes models and datasets on Hugging Face.
openness: Models on Hugging Face; Arabic and multilingual releases.

name: MDZ Digital Library team
summary: Digital library team of the Bavarian State Library known for the widely used dbmdz German, Turkish and Italian BERT and ELECTRA models.
openness: All checked models and tools are public on Hugging Face and GitHub.

name: Mesolitica
summary: Malaysian multimodal AI lab releasing Malay translation, TTS and language models.
openness: Open weights.

name: METR
summary: Nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models for autonomous capabilities and publishes evaluation code and datasets.
openness: MIT-licensed task standard and tools; evaluation analysis data on GitHub.

name: Mila - Quebec AI Institute
summary: Research institute in Montreal founded around Yoshua Bengio's lab; its groups release open research code such as BabyAI and Theano-era frameworks.
openness: Open research code; weights vary by project.

name: MiniMax
summary: Shanghai AI company publishing the MiniMax text and image model families as open weights.
focus: language models; multimodal; image generation; Chinese; English
openness: Open weights on Hugging Face; licence per model card.

name: Mistral AI
summary: Paris-based company building frontier language, vision and speech models. It publishes many of its models as open weights alongside a commercial API.
openness: Many models are released as open weights with Apache-2.0 licences, plus open inference and finetuning code; some flagship models are API-only.

name: Mixedbread

name: Miðeind
summary: Icelandic language technology company that publishes open Icelandic NLP tools, models and evaluation resources.
openness: Tools and models are public on GitHub and Hugging Face with various licences.

name: MLCommons
summary: MLCommons is a consortium that publishes the MLPerf benchmarks, open datasets such as People's Speech and the AILuminate safety benchmark. Reference implementations are on GitHub and datasets on Hugging Face.
openness: Open code and datasets; licences vary.

name: MLRS
summary: Maltese Language Resource Server at the University of Malta, publishing open Maltese language models, corpora and speech data.
openness: Models and corpora are published on the MLRS Hugging Face organisation and the MLRS site.

name: Moondream
summary: Company behind Moondream, a compact open vision-language model family for on-device and edge computer vision.
focus: vision-language models; edge inference; computer vision
openness: Apache-2.0 inference code; model weights and datasets on Hugging Face.

name: Moonshot AI
summary: Beijing company behind the Kimi assistant and model family. It publishes Kimi model weights on Hugging Face.
focus: language models; multimodal; agents; Chinese; English
openness: Open weights on Hugging Face; exact licence stated on each model card.

name: Motif Technologies
summary: Korean AI company publishing Motif base models and open optimizer and activation kernels.
openness: Weights and kernels on Hugging Face.

name: Mozilla.ai
summary: Public benefit company founded by Mozilla (a subsidiary of the Mozilla Foundation) building open-source tools for trustworthy, user-controlled AI such as llamafile, any-llm and any-agent.
openness: Open-source code, mostly permissive licences; affiliated with the Mozilla Foundation.

name: Music Technology Group
summary: Music Technology Group at Universitat Pompeu Fabra, a research group building open-source audio and music analysis software including the Essentia library.

name: NB AI-Lab
summary: AI lab at the National Library of Norway that trains and releases Norwegian language and speech models from the library's digital collections.

name: Neuphonic
summary: UK voice-AI lab building text-to-speech models. It releases on-device TTS models and audio codecs openly.

name: Neuronpedia
summary: Open-source interpretability platform for exploring, visualising and steering model internals such as sparse autoencoder features.
openness: Apache-2.0 platform code with open dashboards data on Hugging Face.

name: NLX Group
summary: Natural Language and Speech group at the University of Lisbon, creators of Albertina and Gervasio Portuguese language models.
openness: Models and datasets are public on Hugging Face under the PORTULAN organisation.

name: Nomic AI
summary: New York company behind open embedding models and GPT4All, a local LLM app.
openness: Open weights, data and training code for embeddings.

name: NorwAI
summary: Norwegian Research Center for AI Innovation at NTNU, publishing open-weight Norwegian language models.
openness: Model weights are public on the NorwAI Hugging Face organisation.

name: Nous Research
summary: Nous Research is an AI lab releasing open models such as the Hermes series, datasets and agent software.
openness: Open weights and code; model licences follow their base models.

name: NovaSky
summary: UC Berkeley Sky Computing Lab group releasing open reasoning models and RL libraries such as Sky-T1 and SkyRL.
openness: Open weights, data and code.

name: NVIDIA
summary: NVIDIA is a large public company best known for GPUs, and it also publishes a broad set of open models, datasets and training software. Its open releases include the Nemotron language models, Cosmos world models, GR00T robotics models, and the NeMo speech toolkit with Parakeet and Canary models.
focus: language models; datasets; speech; robotics; vision
openness: Many NVIDIA models ship as open weights, with datasets and code on Hugging Face and GitHub, but licences vary: the NVIDIA Open Model License covers Nemotron-4 and the Nemotron 3 Nano and Super models, newer Nemotron 3 Ultra and 3.5 models are reported under OpenMDW-1.1, NeMo code is Apache-2.0, and speech models range from CC-BY-4.0 (Parakeet) to CC-BY-NC-4.0 (Canary-1B).

name: NXAI
summary: Linz-based company commercialising xLSTM research from the JKU Linz group. It publishes xLSTM models, TiRex time-series forecasters and kernels.
openness: The xLSTM code is Apache-2.0 and several models are public on Hugging Face.

name: OATML
summary: Oxford Applied and Theoretical Machine Learning group in the Department of Computer Science at the University of Oxford, working on uncertainty, Bayesian deep learning and safe ML, with research code released on GitHub.
openness: Papers ship with public GitHub repositories; the group also hosts datasets and benchmarks on its site.

name: Occiglot
summary: Research collective developing open language models for European languages. It released the Occiglot-7B series and a European LLM leaderboard.
focus: language models; European languages; datasets; evaluation
openness: Models, datasets and evaluation code are public on Hugging Face and GitHub.

name: Open Climate Fix
summary: UK non-profit applying machine learning to energy and climate problems such as solar forecasting. It releases open code, models and datasets.
openness: Code is MIT-licensed and datasets are on Hugging Face.

name: OpenBMB / ModelBest
summary: Open lab for big model base working on foundation models and systems; known for the MiniCPM and MiniCPM-V model lines.
focus: language models; multimodal; efficient models; Chinese
openness: Open weights on Hugging Face and code on GitHub.

name: OpenCSG
summary: Releases open Chinese datasets such as the Fineweb-Edu-Chinese series, and language models, plus a model software stack.
openness: Datasets and models on Hugging Face; stack on GitHub.

name: OpenEuroLLM
summary: EU-funded consortium of European research groups and companies building open multilingual foundation models for European languages. It publishes models, data and evaluations on Hugging Face.

name: OpenGPT-X
summary: German publicly funded research consortium that trained the Teuken open multilingual language models for European languages.

name: OpenHands
summary: Open-source platform and company for AI software-development agents, formerly All Hands AI.

name: OpenLLM France

openness: Models, datasets and training code are public; some code repositories use GPL or AGPL licences.

name: OpenLLM-Ro
summary: Community of Romanian researchers building open Romanian language models and datasets.
openness: Models, datasets and evaluation code are public on Hugging Face and GitHub.

name: OpenMOSS
summary: LLM research group at the Shanghai Innovation Institution working with Fudan University, led by Prof. Xipeng Qiu.
openness: Models on Hugging Face, code on GitHub.

name: OpenThoughts
summary: Open research collective curating fully open datasets and recipes for reasoning models, led with Bespoke Labs and academic partners; releases OpenThoughts datasets and OpenThinker models.

name: Oumi
summary: Public-benefit company behind an unconditionally open-source platform for training, evaluating and deploying foundation models.

openness: Apache-2.0 platform; open HallOumi models and datasets on Hugging Face.

name: Part AI
summary: Iranian company publishing Persian Dorna and Tooka models.
openness: Weights on Hugging Face.

name: Photoroom

name: Physical Intelligence

name: Pleias

name: Pluralis Research

name: Polygl0t
summary: Polygl0t develops open foundation models for low-resource languages, best known for the Tucano family of Portuguese models. It publishes weights, corpora such as GigaVerbo, and training code; the project is linked to the University of Bonn.

name: Polymathic AI
summary: Simons Foundation and Flatiron Institute backed collaboration building open foundation models and datasets for scientific data, notably physics simulation and astronomy.
focus: scientific foundation models; physics simulation; astronomy; datasets
openness: Open code (BSD-3 and MIT) and datasets/models on Hugging Face.

name: Preferred Networks
summary: Japanese deep learning company that publishes the PLaMo model family and related code.
openness: Weights on Hugging Face; licences vary per model.

name: Prime Intellect
summary: Prime Intellect is a decentralized AI lab known for globally distributed training and RL tools, releasing models and code openly.

openness: Open weights, datasets and code.

name: Princeton NLP Group
summary: Academic group releasing open benchmarks, methods and models for language models, including SWE-bench, SimPO and Tree of Thoughts.

name: Prior Labs

name: Projecte Aina

name: Proxecto Nos
summary: Galician language technology project at Universidade de Santiago de Compostela releasing open Galician language models, corpora and speech tools.

name: Pruna AI
summary: Startup working on model efficiency: compression, quantisation and compilation. It open-sources the pruna library and publishes optimised models.

name: pyannoteAI

name: Qatar Computing Research Institute
summary: Research institute of HBKU focused on Arabic technology, multilingual NLP and responsible AI. Government-linked.
openness: Open models and datasets.

name: Reka
summary: Multimodal AI startup that releases some open-weight models (Reka Flash 3) and benchmarks such as Vibe-Eval.

name: rinna
summary: Japanese generative AI company with a long record of releasing pre-trained Japanese models.
openness: Weights on Hugging Face and code on GitHub.

name: Roboflow
summary: Computer-vision platform company that open-sources supervision, RF-DETR and curated datasets.
openness: MIT and Apache-2.0 libraries and models.

name: RWKV
summary: Open-source community behind the RWKV RNN-style language model architecture, now a Linux Foundation AI project. Location is approximate.
openness: Open weights and code (RWKV-LM, RWKV-Runner).

name: Sakana AI
summary: Tokyo R&D company pursuing nature-inspired foundation models. Releases research code, models and Japanese datasets.
focus: language models; evolutionary methods; datasets; Japanese
openness: Open weights, datasets and research code on Hugging Face and GitHub; some products closed.

name: Sapienza NLP
summary: NLP group at Sapienza University of Rome that leads the Minerva family of Italian-English open language models and publishes entity linking, coreference and semantics tools.
focus: language models; Italian; semantics; entity linking
openness: Models, datasets and code are public on Hugging Face and GitHub; licences vary per project.

name: Sarvam AI
summary: Indian startup building models for Indian languages, with several open-weight releases.
openness: Open weights on Hugging Face; no GitHub org listed.

name: Sesame
summary: Speech AI company that open-sourced the CSM-1B conversational speech model.
openness: Open weights for CSM-1B.

name: Shanghai AI Laboratory
summary: Research laboratory that open-sources the Intern family of large language and multimodal models and a full toolchain. Government-backed.
openness: Open weights on Hugging Face and open code on GitHub.

name: Softcatala
summary: Catalan non-profit promoting Catalan in technology with open machine translation, speech and dictionary tools.
openness: Open-source tools, models and datasets on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: SpeakLeash
summary: Open community project collecting Polish text data and building Polish language models. It is the group behind the Bielik models.

name: Sprakbanken Text

name: SRI Lab
summary: Secure, Reliable and Intelligent Systems Lab at ETH Zurich, publishing open code for LLM programming (LMQL), neural network verification and ML for code.

name: Stability AI

name: Stanford CRFM

name: Stanford NLP Group

name: StepFun
summary: Chinese foundation-model company with 50+ models and a dozen datasets on Hugging Face.
openness: Weights released on Hugging Face and code on GitHub; licence per model.

name: Stockmark
summary: Tokyo company that releases Japanese document-reading and language models.
openness: Weights on Hugging Face.

name: Swallow LLM
summary: LLM project led by the Okazaki and Yokota labs at the Institute of Science Tokyo, adapting open models for Japanese.
openness: Weights on Hugging Face, code on GitHub.

name: SWAP Research Group
summary: Semantic Web Access and Personalization group at the University of Bari, creators of the LLaMAntino Italian language models.
openness: Models are public on Hugging Face and code on GitHub; model cards follow Llama licences.

name: Swiss AI Initiative
summary: National initiative of ETH Zurich and EPFL, with partners, that trained the Apertus open language models on the Alps supercomputer. It releases weights, data recipes and training code.

name: TAIDE
summary: Taiwan trustworthy AI dialogue engine project releasing Traditional Chinese models. Government-initiated.
openness: Weights on Hugging Face.

name: TakeLab
summary: Text analysis and knowledge engineering lab at the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing, University of Zagreb.
openness: Several libraries and tools are open on GitHub.

name: TalTech Language Technology
summary: Tallinn University of Technology language technology group publishing Estonian speech and language models on Hugging Face.
openness: Models and datasets are public on the TalTechNLP Hugging Face organisation.

name: TartuNLP
summary: NLP group at the University of Tartu that publishes Estonian and Finno-Ugric language models, speech synthesis and translation tools.
focus: Estonian; speech; machine translation; language models
openness: Models and datasets are public on Hugging Face; code on GitHub is mostly MIT.

name: Te Hiku Media
summary: Te Hiku Media is a Māori iwi media organisation in Kaitaia that builds te reo Māori speech technology under Māori data sovereignty. Its code and a data-sovereignty licence are public on GitHub; some data and models are governed by that licence rather than open licences.

name: Technology Innovation Institute
summary: Research centre of the Abu Dhabi government's Advanced Technology Research Council, publisher of the Falcon models. Government-funded.
openness: Weights on Hugging Face and code on GitHub.

name: The Alan Turing Institute
summary: UK national institute for data science and AI. It maintains a large body of open-source research software and releases some models and datasets.

name: Tilde

name: TNG Technology Consulting

name: Turing Inc.

openness: Weights on Hugging Face, code on GitHub.

name: TurkuNLP

name: UKP Lab
summary: NLP research lab at TU Darmstadt that created Sentence-BERT and publishes open code, models and datasets.

name: Ultralytics
summary: Computer-vision company behind the YOLO model family and the ultralytics library, released under AGPL-3.0 with enterprise licensing.
openness: AGPL-3.0 code and weights with commercial licence available.

name: Unsloth
summary: Open-source project and company making LLM fine-tuning and RL faster and lighter; also publishes quantised model uploads.

name: Upstage
summary: Korean AI company building the Solar language models and document processing engines; some models released openly.
openness: Selected open weights on Hugging Face; commercial API for others.

name: Vector Institute
summary: Toronto nonprofit AI research institute publishing open tools for LLM inference, federated learning and health AI.

name: VISTEC-depa AI Research Institute of Thailand
summary: Thai institute with 200+ models and Thai datasets on Hugging Face.
openness: Models and datasets on Hugging Face.

name: VITA
summary: Visual Intelligence for Transportation lab at EPFL, publishing open code for pose estimation, trajectory prediction and video generation.
openness: Research code is public on GitHub for most papers.

name: Voxel51

name: YTU COSMOS AI Research Group
